user: Any LLM that fetches productsear.ch/?view=llm now gets raw markdown instantly — no more HTML even when the fetcher pretends to be a browser — and the search API can return markdown directly (&format=md).
what: Extended ?view=llm content negotiation with user-agent detection (MARKDOWN_USER_AGENTS in llms.ts) so known LLM/agent clients (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, …) and CLI/script clients (curl, wget, python, …) receive raw text/markdown immediately, even with Accept: text/html. Added markdown output to GET /api/search via ?format=md or Accept: text/markdown (searchApiMd builder). Reworked the llm preamble to lead with a prominent "Search the API" section advertising https://productsear.ch/api/search?q=llm. Updated the served skill doc (/skill.md) and the external E:\skills.te9.dev copy in sync. Updated wiki pages api-search-endpoint and llm-content-negotiation.
why: Many LLM fetchers send Accept: text/html like a browser and used to receive the full HTML page; the search API only spoke JSON; and the API was buried in instruction list item 3 instead of being unmissable.
next: Try curl -H "Accept: text/html" https://productsear.ch/?view=llm (now markdown) and https://productsear.ch/api/search?q=llm&format=md
summary: commits fb62e85 (productsear.ch) + 7f19fc0 (skills.te9.dev). wantsRawMarkdown now checks MARKDOWN_USER_AGENTS; /api/search honors format=md/Accept: text/markdown; llmPreamble + corpusOverviewMd advertise the API with a live example; skill-doc.ts + external SKILL.md document markdown output.

user: LLM clients and CLI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, curl, python…) now get instant raw markdown from productsear.ch, even when they send browser-like headers
what: Raw-markdown detection now matches user agents as well as Accept headers: known LLM/agent fetchers and CLI/script clients are served text/markdown immediately, even when they mimic browsers with Accept: text/html. Real browsers are never matched, so the humans|llms tab switch is unchanged.
why: Most LLM fetchers spoof browser Accept headers, so header-based negotiation silently served them the styled HTML page instead of the document they came for.
next: Fetch any productsear.ch URL with an LLM client or curl — you'll get raw markdown instantly.
